text.text: Trucks, loads, maintenance and driver paperwork on one board. Start with the Dashboard every morning: loads in transit, deliveries due, maintenance overdue and documents about to expire. Follow your own regulator's rules on hours and records; this workspace helps you track dates, not replace those rules.
Every tractor and trailer in the fleet, with status, mileage, service and inspection dates.
Every load from booking to delivered, with pickup, delivery deadline and rate.
Preventive service, repairs and inspections for each truck, with cost.
Licenses, medical cards and training records with their expiry dates.
The fleet at a glance. Charts read the live tables.
